text:
maria: Quick update — HU200 (Hopper Ultra) burst capacity is now available in sa-east1 (Sao Paulo) and ca-tor1 (Toronto) for Dedicated customers. Live as of 2026-06-10 10:00 PT.

maria: We're opening small burst windows initially to validate regional networking and preemption behavior. This release is primarily for latency-sensitive serving use cases that need extra headroom.

kevin: rollout details: 12 HU200 GPUs per zone initially (2 zones in each region). Expected steady-state burst window: 06:00-22:00 local time. Non-guaranteed — subject to preemption for higher-tier reserved pools.

ops-bot: Deploy job #deploy-2457 finished: hu200-pools.sa-east1 provisioning -> SUCCESS :white_check_mark:

maria: Policy notes: new burst fairness will enforce per-org daily GPU-hour cap of 80 GPU-hours across these regions. This is to prevent a small set of tenants from saturating the new pool during ramp.

kevin: If you need larger committed capacity, please file a Dedicated reservation request — burst is not intended as a replacement for reserved capacity. cc @dena for commercial/reservation guidance.

dena: Quick note for sales/AMs — customers using burst beyond the cap will be contacted and offered a migration plan to reserved pools. Billing will show burst usage line-item "dedicated.burst.hu200".

maria: Ops guidance for teams: enable graceful fallback (model variant or region fallback) and set request-level priority if your workload can tolerate preemption. Example fallback policy in config: 
```
fallback: ["mi300-medium", "mi300-small"]
priority: user
```

alec: For infra folks — observability hooks added: token-level latency, preemption_count, and per-request pool_id. If you see >5% preempt for a route ping me.

sre-oncall: Heads-up — we'll run a smoke validation Tuesday 06:00 PT that simulates bursts to ensure routing and fallback behave. Expect some elevated errors ~5-10m during the test window.

kevin: Reservation CLI snippets for quick testing (non-prod only):
```
redwood reserved-reserve --pool hu200 --region sa-east1 --count 2 --duration 2h
redwood infer --model gpt-xl --pool hu200 --region sa-east1 --priority low
```

maria: Action items: 1) Product teams — verify fallback + priority in your dev/staging by EOD Friday. 2) Solutions — share any customer requests for immediate larger reservations. 3) Eng infra — monitor preemption metrics and tag any anomalous IP egress patterns.

dena: FYI — PR to docs console will include a short explainer and billing examples later today. :memo:

maria: Thanks everyone — this is a cautious ramp. Ping me or @kevin for any hot issues. :rocket:
